text:
support-ops: FYI, inbound ticket from Acme: multiple requests to hosted API returning 504/gateway timeouts during a burst around 09:12 UTC. Customer says errors persist ~30s after traffic drops. They pasted a sample curl and trace id.

alerts-bot: ALERT: api.prod.gateway error_rate > 8% (5m) — spike started 2024-06-14T09:11:30Z. Top code: 504 gateway_timeout. avg latency also increased.

customer-ops: Repro steps from Acme:
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Tenant: acme-prod" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
Response: 504 after 30s. Trace: trace-0a1b2c3d

lina-sre: Thanks. Can someone paste gateway logs and autoscaler events? Also which deployment/namespace?

customer-ops: Prod tenant: acme-prod, route: /v1/generate -> service inference-gateway, backend set: inference-hosted-prod.

darshan-eng: Pasting relevant excerpts from gateway and k8s events:
```
[gateway] 2024-06-14T09:11:35Z trace-0a1b2c3d backend upstream: no ready endpoints -> returning 504
[kube-events] 09:11:20 Pod inference-hosted-5c7 not ready, initialDelay exceeded, warming
[keda] ScaledObject/acme-inference: scale to 0 -> failed to trigger for metric queue-length: no metrics available
[k8s-hpa] HPA inference-hosted-prod: currentReplicas=2 desiredReplicas=2 (cpu ok)
```
Looks like backend pods are not ready during burst; HPA not reacting because CPU/memory targets are fine and KEDA trigger (queue-length) isn't firing due to a metric path mismatch.

mike-oncall: Wait — did we just deploy a ScaledObject change last night? Any config drift?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: 2024-06-13 23:18 UTC - config: scaledobject/acme-inference updated (annotations changed: pollingInterval: "30" -> "300", cooldownPeriod: "60" -> "300").

lina-sre: Aha. Increased pollingInterval + cooldown to 300s means KEDA checks less often and suppresses repeat scaling for 5m windows. In a rapid burst the scaler didn't kick fast enough. Also scaledObject target may be pointing to the wrong metric name (we expect redis-list-length but config shows azureQueueLength).

support-ops: Customer impact summary for escalation: 10% of requests 504 for ~3 minutes during peak, customer-facing timeouts, partner SLA hit. Customer requested ETA to resolution.

darshan-eng: Immediate mitigation options:
- Option A: force-scale deployment now: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-hosted-prod --replicas=10 -n prod` (fast, temporary)
- Option B: patch ScaledObject to restore pollingInterval=30 & cooldown=60 and fix trigger metric name (safer, requires quick apply)
- Option C: route this tenant to Dedicated pool as fallback (requires seat/billing check)

mike-oncall: I'll apply option A for immediate relief, then option B as follow-up. Applying scale...

deploy-bot: Command executed by mike-oncall: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-hosted-prod --replicas=10 -n prod`

darshan-eng: Confirming from metrics: replica count increased to 10 at 09:13:05 UTC, HealthyReady pods becoming available 09:13:40. Error rate dropped to baseline ~0.6% by 09:14:20.

support-ops: Notified customer: we scaled their backend to mitigate and will follow up with root cause and permanent fix. They asked for timeline on config fix.

lina-sre: Action items:
- Restore ScaledObject pollingInterval/cooldown and correct trigger metric name (darshan)
- Add prewarm policy for bursty tenants (lina)
- Add an alert that catches scaler-suppression on burst (mike)
- Postmortem and customer RCA (support-ops)

darshan-eng: Patching ScaledObject now: `kubectl apply -f acme/scaledobject-patch.yaml` (will switch pollingInterval to 30, cooldown 60, trigger.metricName -> redisListLength)

deploy-bot: Patch applied by darshan-eng at 09:18:02 UTC. KEDA check ran, scaled to desired as soon as queue metric observed.

mike-oncall: Confirming no more 504s in last 20m. Closing immediate escalation. Will create postmortem ticket and schedule follow-up with customer.

support-ops: Thanks team. Logging this thread into incident tracker and assigning postmortem. Customer notified and offered 1:1 call. :white_check_mark:

customer-ops: Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick fix — please send RCA and steps to avoid recurrence."

lina-sre: Will include recommended defaults: pollingInterval <= 30 for bursty tenants, lower cooldown for scaledobjects, and a prewarm feature flag for high-throughput tenants.

mike-oncall: Closing notes: suspect change made during config cleanups last night; will require a small change in our deploy gate to warn on large cooldown changes.

support-ops: Incident closed for now; postmortem ticket: PM-2024-1782 assigned.
